verdict.rationale: Databricks offers several dev-loop mechanisms — Free Edition (a no-cost, sandbox-like cloud workspace for experimentation, docs-66/73/74), Databricks Connect for developing/debugging in a local IDE against Databricks compute (docs-47/64/76), and dbt Core for writing/testing transformations on a local machine before running them (docs-14/35/10) — which together let a data engineer iterate before touching full production infrastructure. However, none of these is a true local engine/emulator that runs Spark/Delta transformations fully offline; Free Edition and Databricks Connect still rely on Databricks-hosted compute rather than a local sandbox.  missing for 10: a genuine offline/local execution engine or emulator, clear separation guarantee from production clusters, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the dev-loop experience.
